svg.title: AI Cheatsheet screen tour
svg.desc: An animated tour cycling through the real AI Cheatsheet Models, Lookup, and Stack screens.

g.text: API-ready model IDs, status, and one-line fit notes. These are the names you copy into code.
Find apps, agents, APIs, subscriptions, and tools mentioned in vendor docs.
Assistant app for daily AI work.
OpenAI's assistant app for chatting, writing, research, files, voice, and coding help.
It is a finished app, not the same thing as the OpenAI API.
Set your job and constraints. Copy the result into a ticket or planning doc.
11 models in the local reference set. Treat this as a shortlist; verify pricing, limits, and docs before shipping.
Use lookup for product names, models for API IDs, and vocabulary when a vendor page gets vague.
